QuestionStmt.S: Which among the following is NOT dicarboxylic acid?

Solution.S:
Dicarboxylic acids contain two carboxyl (-COOH) groups.

- Adipic acid: HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH (hexanedioic acid) → dicarboxylic.
- Glutaric acid: HOOC-(CH₂)₃-COOH (pentanedioic acid) → dicarboxylic.
- Valeric acid: CH₃-(CH₂)₃-COOH (pentanoic acid) → monocarboxylic.
- Malonic acid: HOOC-CH₂-COOH (propanedioic acid) → dicarboxylic.

Thus valeric acid is not a dicarboxylic acid, corresponding to option C.
